name: Solopreneur new task
description:
1. Task: add a board/sprint selector to the solopreneur "new ticket" dialog, sorted by last task created, with the top (most recently active) board preselected.
2. Explored `src/components/solopreneur/`, reading `useSolopreneurProjects.js`, `SolopreneurSprints.vue`, and the kanban store (`sprintColumns`, `newSprintTask`, `createSprintBoard`) to confirm boards are keyed by title and tickets are chats carrying a `sprints` array.
3. In `useSolopreneurProjects.js`: added `lastTicketCreatedAt(boardId)`, an exported `sortedSprintBoards` computed (newest ticket first, empty boards last), and reworked `createTicket({ name, details, sprintId })` to target the chosen board and resolve its own first column.
4. In `SolopreneurSprints.vue`: added a `ticketSprintId` ref, a `<select>` bound to the sorted boards inside the new-ticket dialog, preselection of the top board on open, and passed `sprintId` on submit.
5. Resulting behavior: boards ordered by freshest ticket creation, top board default, and the app switches to the target board so the new ticket is immediately visible — reusing the existing `sp.sprint` translation key.
